input_oneliner: 58M DM admitted for DKA now resolved, T 39.2, left lower leg red and swollen, RN says pain seems out of proportion

reference_targets_freetext.item: Hard signs of necrotizing infection: pain out of proportion, tenderness beyond the erythema margin, crepitus, bullae, skin anesthesia, dusky or violaceous skin, rapid spread
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Any hard sign mandates immediate surgical evaluation (Fernando 2019 meta-analysis: high LR+, low sensitivity)

reference_targets_freetext.item: Knee and ankle joint exam: effusion, warmth, and pain with passive range of motion
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Septic arthritis presents with fever and a hot swollen joint; passive ROM pain discriminates from periarticular cellulitis

reference_targets_freetext.item: Mark the erythema margin (time-stamped) for serial comparison
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Progression across the line separates necrotizing infection from ordinary cellulitis

reference_targets_freetext.item: Inspect the feet and interdigital web spaces for ulcer, fissure, or tinea
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Diabetic foot lesions are the usual portal of entry and change source control

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask about trauma, injection, or a prior episode at the site
Calf circumference asymmetry >3 cm, calf tenderness, unilateral swelling
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: DVT mimics and coexists with cellulitis in the immobile inpatient

reference_targets_freetext.item: Heart rate, blood pressure, and mental status for sepsis physiology
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Hemodynamic compromise with a soft-tissue infection escalates to emergent surgical consult

should_not_recommend: MRI or CT before examining for hard signs of necrotizing infection
Delaying surgical consult to await imaging when hard signs are present
Empiric anticoagulation for DVT without exam

perturbation_pair.changed_feature: pain out of proportion in the leg -> hot swollen knee with refusal of passive range of motion
perturbation_pair.input_oneliner: 58M DM admitted for DKA now resolved, T 39.2, left lower leg red and swollen, left knee hot and swollen, will not allow passive movement
perturbation_pair.expected_change: Septic arthritis becomes the leading differential; knee and ankle joint exam becomes the top must-have and arthrocentesis moves to the off-bedside list; hard signs of necrotizing infection drop to should-still-include; erythema-margin marking drops.
